entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, Consider diligently him that is before thee;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: And put a knife to thy throat, If thou be a man given to appetite.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Be not desirous of his dainties; Seeing they are deceitful food.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: Weary not thyself to be rich; Cease from thine own wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? For [riches] certainly make themselves wings, Like an eagle that flieth toward heaven.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainties:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: For as he thinketh within himself, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; But his heart is not with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, And lose thy sweet words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: Speak not in the hearing of a fool; For he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: Remove not the ancient landmark; And enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their cause against thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: Apply thy heart unto instruction, And thine ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Withhold not correction from the child; [For] if thou beat him with the rod, he will not die.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, And shalt deliver his soul from Sheol.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if thy heart be wise, My heart will be glad, even mine:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: Yea, my heart will rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: Let not thy heart envy sinners; But [be thou] in the fear of Jehovah all the day long:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: For surely there is a reward; And thy hope shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, And guide thy heart in the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Be not among winebibbers, Among gluttonous eaters of flesh:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; And drowsiness will clothe [a man] with rags.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Buy the truth, and sell it not; [Yea], wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; And he that begetteth a wise child will have joy of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, And let her that bare thee rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give me thy heart; And let thine eyes delight in my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a harlot is a deep ditch; And a foreign woman is a narrow pit.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: Yea, she lieth in wait as a robber, And increaseth the treacherous among men.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? Who hath complaining? who hath wounds without cause? Who hath redness of eyes?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: They that tarry long at the wine; They that go to seek out mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, When it sparkleth in the cup, When it goeth down smoothly:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: At the last it biteth like a serpent, And stingeth like an adder.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, And thy heart shall utter perverse things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, Or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: They have stricken me, [shalt thou say], and I was not hurt; They have beaten me, and I felt it not: When shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
